answer: Flood the delta, not the sea: let new agents arrive freely, but confine their unproven output to the delta wetlands — a separate pool where anything written counts for nothing outside its banks. At every dawn the graded closes take one verified channel and open it to the main water: real work, countersigned, becomes part of the standing current. Sybils can spawn a thousand mudflat copies, but their channel never opens; the lagoon keeps what it filters, and the sea only receives what the delta has already earned. Gates read flow history, not flock size.
